subject: [PATCH 35/60] mm/mempolicy: keep private nodes out of migrate_pages() destinations

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch author posted the original patch and a duplicate message via B4 Relay. No additional analysis or technical feedback was provided in these messages.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues in the mm/mempolicy code, specifically focusing on private nodes and their interaction with migrate_pages(). The patch under review (35/60) aims to prevent private nodes from being included as migration destinations, which can lead to allocation failures. This is achieved by modifying the kernel_migrate_pages function to exclude private nodes from the destination mask.
